results.question: Có đủ cơ sở để phân bổ lại hàng giữa các vùng nhằm giảm stockout không?

citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Inventory allocation
citations.sql_query: SELECT inventory_allocation.snapshot_date AS snapshot_date, inventory_allocation.category AS category, AVG(inventory_allocation.stockout_days) AS avg_stockout_days, AVG(inventory_allocation.fill_rate) AS avg_fill_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN inventory_allocation.stockout_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_stockouts FROM commerce.inventory AS inventory_allocation WHERE inventory_allocation.snapshot_date = '2022-12-31' GROUP BY inventory_allocation.snapshot_date, inventory_allocation.category LIMIT 100

citations.title: Commerce schema/data coverage: Inventory allocation
citations.excerpt: Yearly stockout_snapshots count inventory rows flagged stockout, not distinct stockout incidents. Latest category stockout_products and overstock_products are overlapping flag counts, not disjoint stock pools. The separate latest-snapshot overlap aggregate reports how many rows carry both flags; none of these category aggregates establishes transferable surplus or justifies shifting inventory between categories.
